test_simple_and_background: test the _rewrite_compound_background function rewrites 'A && B &' to 'A && { B & }'
test_chained_and: test the _rewrite_compound_background function rewrites chained 'A && B && C &' to 'A && B && { C & }'
test_realistic_server_start: test the _rewrite_compound_background function rewrites a realistic server start command with cd and http.server
test_redirects_not_confused: test the _rewrite_compound_background function preserves '&>' and '2>&1' redirects without misinterpreting them as background operators
test_quoting_and_parens: test the _rewrite_compound_background function skips rewriting shell metacharacters inside quotes, parentheses, and comments
